sloka: स तदा भाषमाणम् तु भ्रातरम् विप्र घातिनम् ।अब्रवीत् प्रहसन् धीमान् अगस्त्यो मुनि सत्तमः ॥३-११-६३॥
transliteration: sa tadā bhāṣamāṇam tu bhrātaram vipra ghātinam ।abravīt prahasan dhīmān agastyo muni sattamaḥ ॥3-11-63॥

translations.english: Saying, the ritual is complete Ilvala offered water in the palm of Agastya and called his brother to come out.
